text: Knockdown of TMED5 (which accumulates in APOE4 lysosomes) re-acidified lysosomes in HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells without changing lysosomal density, and restored proteolysis - identifying TMED5 accumulation as a driver of the APOE4 alkalinization (again opposite in direction to the hypothesis of APOE4-driven acidification) (reported: 0.64 vs 1.0 normalized OG(alkaline:acidic) ratio upon siTmed5 (more acidic); MR-CTSB ~0.84 vs ~0.51).
description: HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells transfected twice over 48 h with Tmed5 siRNA vs scrambled control; OregonGreen-dextran ratiometric pH imaging, LysoTracker, Magic Red cathepsin B; three biological/technical replicates. Caveat: mouse neuronal cell line; knockdown is a surrogate perturbation for the APOE isoform difference.

provenance.excerpt: We confirmed by lysosomal Oregon-green pH measurements that knockdown of TMED5 significantly enhanced lysosomal acidification in HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells, while not impacting the lysosomal density (Figure 5C-E).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE4 -> TMED5 accumulation) -> (lysosomal alkalinization); TMED5 knockdown -> (restored acidification) [CONTRADICTS]

warnings: effect size '~0.64 vs 1.0 normalized OG(alkaline:acidic) ratio upon siTmed5 (more acidic); MR-CTSB ~0.84 vs ~0.51' has no accepted form: recorded as qualitative, numbers kept in description

perturbed.variable: siRNA knockdown of Tmed5 in HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells (reversal of an APOE4-induced change)

measured.variable: Relative lysosomal pH by OregonGreen-dextran ratio, LysoTracker intensity and MR-CTSB proteolysis
